subject: Game Theory
title: Logrolling
description: A micro-lesson that makes Logrolling usable.

hook.text: You want a higher salary. Your employer wants you to relocate. Neither issue matters equally to both sides.

buildup.text: Logrolling trades concessions on different issues: 'I'll accept relocation if you raise my salary by 20%.'

discovery.text: It works because the cost of conceding on one issue is less than the gain received on the other.

twist.text: The challenge: neither side wants to reveal which issue they value most. That information is leverage.

climax.text: In politics, logrolling passes laws: 'Vote for my bridge, I'll vote for your school.' Everyone wins—in theory.

punchline.text: Trade what costs you little for what matters.
